title: An AI-enabled high-resolution chlorophyll-a forecasting model that outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system
abstract: arXiv:2611.17704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Surface chlorophyll-a concentration is a key indicator of marine phytoplankton variability, and short-term forecasts of its distribution provide advance information for marine ecosystem monitoring and management. However, interactions between physical transport and biological processes complicate chlorophyll-a forecasting, and simulating these coupled processes with conventional numerical models imposes substantial computational demands. Here we introduce ChlCast, an AI model that generates daily forecasts of surface chlorophyll-a concentration over a 10-day horizon at approximately 4-km resolution between 60$^\circ$S and 60$^\circ$N. ChlCast combines factorized spatiotemporal convolutions with a multiscale architecture to learn from historical chlorophyll-a fields and climatological information. translated_title: 一种超越业务化全球生物地球化学系统的AI高分辨率叶绿素a预测模型
translated_abstract: 表层叶绿素a浓度是海洋浮游植物变化的关键指标，对其分布的短期预报可为海洋生态系统监测与管理提供前瞻性信息。然而，物理输送与生物过程之间的相互作用使叶绿素a预测变得复杂，而用传统数值模式模拟这些耦合过程需要巨大的计算开销。本文提出ChlCast，这是一个AI模型，可在南纬60°至北纬60°之间以约4公里的分辨率生成未来10天的逐日表层叶绿素a浓度预报。ChlCast将分解式时空卷积与多尺度架构相结合，从历史叶绿素a场和气候学信息中学习。与业务化的0.25°哥白尼全球海洋生物地球化学预报系统相比，ChlCast降低了平均绝对误差并……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究提出AI模型ChlCast，利用分解式时空卷积与多尺度架构，以约4公里分辨率生成全球10天逐日表层叶绿素a预报，其精度超越了业务化的哥白尼全球海洋生物地球化学预报系统。
en_tdlr: ChlCast is an AI model combining factorized spatiotemporal convolutions with a multiscale architecture to generate daily 10-day global surface chlorophyll-a forecasts at ~4-km resolution, outperforming the operational Copernicus global ocean biogeochemical forecasting system.
